blocks.intro: The Fox River runs right through Algonquin. It hit a record 12.70 feet here in April 2013, and in July 2017 volunteers filled more than 25,000 sandbags.

items.body: When the river is up, groundwater rises with it and sump pumps run for days.
A battery backup keeps pumping when the main pump loses power.
More than half of Algonquin homes went up between 1990 and 2009, many with finished lower levels.
Discharge lines buried under beds or lawn can freeze or clog. We route them so water leaves the yard.

blocks.h2: Sump Pump Questions From Algonquin Homeowners

items.q: How do I keep my basement dry when the Fox River rises?
items.preview: Test the pump, add a battery backup and keep the discharge clear.
items.answer: Test your pump before the rain: pour a bucket of water into the pit and watch it turn on. Add a battery backup, keep the discharge line clear and pointed away from the house, and protect floor drains with a backflow valve.

items.q: How long do sump pumps last?
items.answer: Most last somewhere around 7 to 10 years, less if they run often near the river.

items.q: Do I really need a battery backup?
items.preview: If your basement is finished, yes.
items.answer: If your basement is finished or holds anything you care about, yes. Storms and power outages often come together.

items.q: Can you upgrade to a stronger pump?
items.preview: Yes, matched to your pit and discharge.
items.answer: Yes. If your pump can't keep up, we'll install a higher-capacity pump and make sure the pit and discharge match it.

items.q: Where should my sump pump discharge go in a landscaped yard?
items.preview: Away from the house, without soaking beds or freezing.
items.answer: Far enough from the foundation that water doesn't come back, routed so it doesn't flood planting beds or freeze in winter. We'll suggest a route that works with your landscaping.

items.q: What does sump pump replacement cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on the pump and backup. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, any pit or check valve work and whether you add a backup. We quote a flat rate before we start.
